verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents full ClickHouse compatibility: native protocol and HTTP interface, unchanged SQL and clients, plain MergeTree DDL, and the s3()/url() table functions working as documented. That implies data can be pulled out with standard ClickHouse tooling and object storage. However, the migration docs only describe moving data into ObsessionDB, and no export, egress, or offboarding path is documented. missing for 10: explicit documented bulk export of all data, open-format output (e.g., Parquet/CSV to object storage) described as an exit path, export of schema/metadata, independent corroboration of leaving.
